problem_observed: A GD-VLV + GD-SH concept was treated as a tapered roller-guide placement problem only, missing the analogous C1 GD-SH + stiff-component EDIKB evidence for placement, length, non-additive response, and strain implications.
proposed_change: When GD-VLV and GD-SH are both present or requested, classify the design as a stiff inline component inside a shroud, retrieve ILS-SHTP / GD-SH + GD-TP/GD-TT evidence by analogy, and flag EDIKB_USEFULNESS_JUDGEMENT_FAILURE if those nodes or rows are omitted.
evidence_requirement: Focused regression tests for intent extraction, retrieval of C1 SHTP evidence, and judgement-failure reporting.

implementation_ref.notes: Implemented shroud_stiff_component intent, deterministic C1/SHTP retrieval expansion, and EDIKB usefulness judgement flag.
